d: Bihar ke navada jile se ek hairan karne vala mamla samne aaya hai. nagar thana kshetr ke nanhu nagar mohalle men ek pati ne kathit taur par ek maulana par apni patni ko premjal men phansakar char bachchon ke sath le jane ka ganbhir aarop lagaya hai. is sanbandh men pirit pati mohammad phiroj aalam ne navada nagar thana men likhit aavedan dekar pulis se nyay ki guhar lagaee hai aur apni patni va charon bachchon ki baramadgi ki mang ki hai.
